<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="pinkOrange" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="keyShadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="130%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="19" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="13" x2="322" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="11" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="9" x2="330" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="7" x2="334" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M344 17 Q349 10 354 17 M347 17 Q349 13 351 17" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="349" cy="18" r="1.2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="362" y="8" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="385" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="365" y="11" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="30,61 20,71 30,81" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="75" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Verify your number</text>
    <line x1="0" y1="101" x2="390" y2="101" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main verification content -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Enter verification code</text>
    <text x="195" y="181" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">We sent a 6-digit code to</text>
    <text x="195" y="207" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">+1 (415) 555-0186</text>

    <!-- Six code fields -->
    <rect x="43" y="258" width="42" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="url(#pinkOrange)"/>
    <rect x="101" y="258" width="42" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="159" y="258" width="42" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="217" y="258" width="42" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="275" y="258" width="42" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="333" y="258" width="42" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="64" y="247" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#4A4A4A">7</text>
    <circle cx="122" cy="237" r="4" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="195" y="302" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">The code expires in 09:42</text>
    <text x="195" y="338" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4396F7">Didn't get a code? Resend</text>
    <text x="195" y="374" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Wrong number?</text>
    <text x="195" y="398" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Edit phone number</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="90" y="425" width="210" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#pinkOrange)"/>
      <text x="195" y="452" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Numeric keypad -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="564" width="390" height="280" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="564" x2="390" y2="564" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

    <g filter="url(#keyShadow)">
      <rect x="7" y="572" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="135" y="572" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="263" y="572" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="7" y="638" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="135" y="638" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="263" y="638" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="7" y="704" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="135" y="704" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="263" y="704" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="135" y="770" width="119" height="57" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    </g>

    <text x="66" y="609" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">1</text>
    <text x="194" y="609" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">2</text>
    <text x="194" y="622" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">ABC</text>
    <text x="322" y="609" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">3</text>
    <text x="322" y="622" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">DEF</text>

    <text x="66" y="675" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">4</text>
    <text x="66" y="688" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">GHI</text>
    <text x="194" y="675" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">5</text>
    <text x="194" y="688" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">JKL</text>
    <text x="322" y="675" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">6</text>
    <text x="322" y="688" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">MNO</text>

    <text x="66" y="741" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">7</text>
    <text x="66" y="754" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">PQRS</text>
    <text x="194" y="741" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">8</text>
    <text x="194" y="754" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">TUV</text>
    <text x="322" y="741" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">9</text>
    <text x="322" y="754" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">WXYZ</text>

    <text x="194" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">0</text>
    <text x="66" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4A4A4A">⌫</text>
    <polyline points="55,801 62,795 75,795" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="335,799 343,807 351,799" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="159" y1="839" x2="231" y2="839" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
